summary.text: Phil Greazzo is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former state representative who won a Hillsborough 17 seat in 2010.

paragraphs.text: Greazzo's career experience, as listed by Ballotpedia, includes work as a manager at Nortel, a fabricator at Texas Instruments and Hewlett-Packard, and a technician at N-Trek.
Greazzo won election to the New Hampshire House from Hillsborough 17 on November 2, 2010, and in the 2011-2012 session served on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee.
In 2012 he was the unopposed Republican nominee for New Hampshire State Senate District 20 and lost the general election to incumbent Lou D'Allesandro, receiving 36.9 percent of the vote.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records show that he sought a Hillsborough 7 House seat in 2018 and lost the primary.
